before: No op wrote a paragraph beside a block, so the slot outside a block control's tag had no place for typing or Enter.
after: insertParagraph { at: { before | after: blockId }, text? } writes a paragraph at a place between blocks and publishes it as the caret; the surface sends it for typing and Enter in the slot outside a block tag.
reason: The op reduces to one children replacement in the container it writes into, which the journal already replicates; released participants receive the resulting shared state, never the new op kind.
